tex_content.html:
Definition

A category is small if both its object class and its morphism class are sets. It is locally small if $\operatorname {Hom}_{\mathrm C}(X,Y)$ is a set for every pair of objects $X,Y$. Each category in Example 7 is locally small but not small.
